headline: Career Decision Matrix, from entry to detail
overview: Create weighted decision matrices to compare job offers or career paths. Assign weights to criteria that matter most to you, score each option, and let the math reveal your best choice.
targetAudience: Users interested in career tools for personal growth and self-discovery.

steps.title: Career Decision Matrix — Landing State

steps.screenshotAlt: Career Decision Matrix landing page on desktop

keyFeatures: Create custom weighted criteria for any career decision (job offers, role changes, company choices)
Score multiple options against each criterion and see weighted totals automatically calculated
Visual comparison making it easy to see which option aligns best with your priorities
Saves matrices for future reference — track your decision reasoning over time
tips: Weight your criteria before scoring any options — deciding what matters most upfront prevents you from reverse-engineering weights to justify the option you already prefer.
If the top-scoring option feels wrong, trust that feeling — the matrix surfaces hidden preferences you may not have consciously recognized, making it worth examining why you're resisting the result.
